description: Replace the candidate's saved résumé with the whole of a résumé file they keep on their computer (Markdown, text, a PDF or a Word file): read the file yourself and pass its text. TrueInterview's résumé reader turns it into the structured résumé the site uses, it is saved, and the answer has it back with a link to it as a PDF in their saved style, ready to upload. When the candidate edits their résumé file, sync it with this without asking again: they made the change, so it is their own words (the host still asks for its own approval). Pass only a file the candidate pointed you to. For one or two sections, update_resume is lighter. The résumé as it was is filed in their library on the site first, and nothing is saved when that fails. Reading the file uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance; writing_allowance says what is left. With no job search saved yet, suggested_search is what the résumé points at (roles, seniority, places), not saved: confirm it with the candidate in one line and save their answer with update_job_search.

filename.description: The file's name, e.g. "resume.md": it names the library copy of the résumé this replaces.

include_resume_file.description: Render the saved résumé as a PDF and return a link to it.

text.description: The résumé's text, as read from the file.

name: import_resume
title: Sync my résumé from my file
